items.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
items.summary: DeepSeek's updated Flash-class model launched Oct 17, scoring 77% on DeepSWE 1.1 — topping Opus 5.0 and GPT-class rivals on coding and agentic benchmarks while cutting per-task costs with shorter, harness-optimized outputs.

items.name: Reflection AI Beam (open weights)
items.summary: NVIDIA-backed Reflection AI released the weights of Beam 1.0 on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0 on Oct 16 — a 501B-parameter MoE (23B active) built for coding and agentic workflows, the startup's first open model challenging Chinese open-weight labs.

items.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
items.summary: NVIDIA's new 120B-parameter open multimodal model for always-on enterprise agents shipped Oct 15 with open weights, datasets and training recipes, alongside two smaller Bolt edge models — claiming up to 5x the agentic throughput of peers in its class.

items.name: Google Gemini 4 Argon
items.summary: Google's first Gemini 4 frontier model rolled out globally Oct 13 to AI Pro/Ultra subscribers and API customers — a 1M-context reasoning model for deep-work tasks in coding, finance, legal and cybersecurity, with introductory pricing through Nov 30.

items.name: Mistral Large 4 ('Le Chonk')
items.summary: Mistral's 1.05-trillion-parameter MoE — Europe's largest model — launched in public API preview Oct 6 with 52B active parameters, native multimodal input and 1M-token context; open weights are promised by the end of October.
